construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

2020 Initial Study (SP19-065, T19-042): demolish a gas station; five-story building with about 8,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, about 5,000 sq ft of second-floor office, three residential levels with 27 units, and two underground parking levels. Applicant listed as KT Urban, Mark Tersini.
The state report's 2019 application row lists 27 units as disapproved; its 2020 entitlement row reports approval of 27 units on 2020-10-22.

In October 2023 the City of San Jose circulated an MND (SCH 2023100474) for a seven-story, 85-foot hotel with 176 rooms on this site, with a General Plan amendment, rezoning and Special Use Permit; SF YIMBY reports KT Urban as applicant, Lowney Architecture as architect, 45 parking spaces, and a preliminary application filed in 2022. Neither source mentions housing units.
C2K Architecture lists The Olin Condominiums as an unbuilt 5-story, 110,200 sq ft mixed-use building with 27 residential units in the Santana Row Urban Village.
